title: Cell calling
methods:
**Data and truth.** The cohort's 10x datasets from FASTQs, plus the Kang 2018 control lane. Truth for 10x datasets is the filtered barcodes 10x published (Cell Ranger 2.1 / 3.0), for Kang the authors' demuxlet table. Both are cutoff-based, so a barcode beyond the truth is not necessarily wrong.

**Calls.** Singlet: the called_v2 column (EmptyDrops on the stored exon+intron counts, plateau ambient bound, knee fitted within DropletUtils' curve bounds, FDR 0.001, 10,000 draws, union with the stored knee call). STARsolo 2.7.11b EmptyDrops_CR in Cell Ranger 4+ emulation on the same reads. CellBender 0.3.2 on STARsolo's raw Gene matrix, expected cells and droplets read off the raw UMI curve (Cell Ranger 2.2 rule), other options at defaults.

**Metrics.** Over the union of every tool's calls and the truth: recall, precision and Jaccard of each tool's calls against the truth. In the barnyard, also the share of each tool's called barcodes whose human fraction cannot be told from the ambient one.

**Rules.** match_or_beat the best competitor on each metric; tolerance = half-width of the paired bootstrap 95% CI of the difference (barcodes resampled together). Precision and recall are both gated, so a method that trades one for the other will fail one of them.

**Broader evidence.** The 42-sample validation of docs/called-v2.md (authors' calls in 9 public studies) is reported as an informational pooled metric; it was not run on the campaign binary.

tools.name: singlet
tools.params: singlet encode --reads R1.fastq.gz R2.fastq.gz -o s.1fq; singlet s.1fq --ref-base $REF --genome-dir $REF/$SPECIES/star_2.7.11b --exons $REF/$SPECIES/genes/genes.gtf --out-prefix $OUT/ --threads 8 --pipeline --output-format mtx --raw-matrix  (calls = called_v2 column of cell_calls.tsv: EmptyDrops on the stored counts, FDR 0.001, 10,000 draws)

tools.name: starsolo-edcr
tools.citation: Lun et al. EmptyDrops: distinguishing cells from empty droplets in droplet-based single-cell RNA sequencing data. Genome Biol 2019 (EmptyDrops_CR is STARsolo's port of Cell Ranger's variant)
tools.params: STAR --runThreadN 16 --genomeDir $GENOME --readFilesIn $R2 $R1 --readFilesCommand zcat --soloType CB_UMI_Simple --soloCBwhitelist $WHITELIST --soloCBlen 16 --soloUMIstart 17 --soloUMIlen $UMILEN --soloBarcodeReadLength 0 --soloStrand $STRAND --soloFeatures Gene GeneFull Velocyto SJ --soloCellFilter EmptyDrops_CR --soloCBmatchWLtype 1MM_multi_Nbase_pseudocounts --soloUMIfiltering MultiGeneUMI_CR --soloUMIdedup 1MM_CR --clipAdapterType CellRanger4 --outFilterScoreMin 30 --outSAMtype None; calls = Solo.out/Gene/filtered (10x v1 for Kang: CB 14, UMI 10)

tools.name: cellbender
tools.citation: Fleming et al. Unsupervised removal of systematic background noise from droplet-based single-cell experiments using CellBender. Nat Methods 2023
tools.params: cellbender remove-background --cuda --input <STARsolo Solo.out/Gene/raw> --output cb.h5 --expected-cells $EXP --total-droplets-included $TOT --fpr 0.01 --epochs 150; EXP = barcodes at or above 1/10 of the 99th percentile of the top 3000 barcodes' UMI (Cell Ranger 2.2 rule from the raw curve), TOT = max(3 x EXP, 10000); calls = cb_cell_barcodes.csv

figures.title: Jaccard of called barcodes with the truth set
figures.caption: Higher is better.

caveats: called_v2's parameters (plateau ambient bound, knee bounds, tail p-values, FDR 0.001) were chosen and corrected while looking at pbmc1k_v3, hgmm1k_v3, neuron1k_v3, nuclei2k_v2, pbmc5p_v1 and the Kang lane (docs/called-v2-truth.md). Those datasets are development data for this method, so these scores are not held-out; the 42-sample validation is broader but was also used to choose among variants.

The truth sets are themselves cutoff-based (Cell Ranger OrdMag / EmptyDrops-like, demuxlet on called cells). Barcodes called by Singlet beyond them are often real low-RNA cells (docs/called-v2-truth.md) and count against precision here.

The Cell Ranger truth for each 10x dataset is the matrix 10x published, not a re-run on the 2024-A reference. It is itself the output of a cell-calling algorithm (EmptyDrops-like, or OrdMag for Cell Ranger 2), and STARsolo EmptyDrops_CR is a port of it, so its agreement with that truth is partly by construction. The independent real truths are the barnyard species composition (hgmm1k_v3) and the Kang demuxlet table (genotype-based).

CellBender stopped with an encoder assertion (fewer than 4 cells in a minibatch) at its defaults and again at a lower learning rate on some datasets (see provenance.json); those datasets have no CellBender column and no CellBender competitor value.

CellBender's expected-cells and total-droplets parameters were derived from the raw UMI curve with a fixed rule, not tuned; CellBender ran only on the datasets that have a cellbender column in the artifacts.
Wall time and memory in resources are from a shared cluster at differing thread counts and are not a speed comparison.

Cohort datasets assigned to cell-calling that this document does not cover (no run for them in this benchmark yet): pbmc5k_v4_d1, pbmc10k_5p_v2, mouse_brain_nuclei5k_v31, pbmc_multiome10k, pbmc10k_cite_v3, stoeckius2018_hashing, hgmm10k_v3, macosko2015_dropseq_mix, tenx_crispr_a375_10k, ding2020_pbmc1_smartseq2, ding2020_pbmc1_dropseq, ding2020_pbmc1_indrops, ding2020_pbmc1_seqwell, ding2020_pbmc1_celseq2, ding2020_pbmc1_10xv3, heart1k_v3.
conclusion: On 8 datasets Singlet's called_v2 reaches Jaccard 0.83-0.95 with the truth set (recall 0.91-1.00, precision 0.88-0.98), compared with STARsolo EmptyDrops_CR and CellBender; 5 of 25 gating comparisons pass. The 10x truth sets come from Cell Ranger's own EmptyDrops-type call, which STARsolo's EmptyDrops_CR reproduces by construction; only the barnyard species check and the Kang demuxlet table are independent of that algorithm. Singlet loses 20 comparisons (see metrics).
